optimizedDescription.value: DiffGenerator produces presentation-neutral unified file diffs behind a typed, swappable core capability.

optimizedContext.value:
# DiffGenerator

## Rules
- TypeScript interface `DiffGenerator`, not abstract class; exposes `generate({ filename, base, merged, contextLines? }): string`.
- `base` may be empty for newly introduced artifacts.
- Return plain unified diff: no ANSI, controls, or host separators. Labels: `a/<filename> (base)` and `b/<filename> (merged)`.
- Omitted `contextLines` defaults to 3.
- Dedicated `DiffGenerationError` distinguishes non-fatal diff-surface failure from merge/artifact-preview failure; default implementation raises it when usable unified diff cannot be produced.
- Core provides default factory; concrete diff library remains encapsulated.
- Internal shared preview capability suitable for `PreviewSpec`; delivery hosts need not use it for unrelated workflows.

## Constraints
- Port lives `application/ports/`; port has no concrete diff-library dependency.
- Plain text only; presentation outside port.
- Models file-to-file unified diffs, not semantic comments or artifact filtering.
